title: Contractor Dispatch Standard for the Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
A contractor is dispatched on a rider service request of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons only while the rider status is active, as Bridgewell's records of the rider show.

## Selecting the contractor

The request goes to a network contractor:

1. whose trade matches the rider component: pool and spa, septic, well pump, roofing, appliance, or the trade of the guest unit item; and
2. whose service ZIP codes include the base property's ZIP code.

Among the contractors meeting both conditions, a preferred contractor goes before a standard one, and a suspended contractor is never used. Ties go to the contractor reference that sorts first alphabetically.

## Contact windows

Emergency handling applies only when the rider is one with emergency service available, with contact within the rider's emergency contact hours. Otherwise contact is within the rider's routine contact hours.

| Rider has emergency service available | Request urgency | Contact window |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Emergency | The rider's emergency contact hours |
| Yes | Routine | The rider's routine contact hours |
| No | Any | The rider's routine contact hours |

## Re-dispatch

A missed contact window leads to re-dispatch. Each assignment on a request carries the next dispatch sequence number, starting at 1 for the first assignment.

**Hypothetical case.** On a Bridgewell Septic System Rider request, two preferred septic contractors serve the property's ZIP code, with references beginning "C" and "F". The request goes to the contractor whose reference begins with "C". If the contact window is missed, the request is re-dispatched and the new assignment carries sequence number 2.
